reason: I have one apartment next to my house and I answer the guests myself, ChatGPT already helps me translate. €150 plus €35 every month of the season is a few nights of my profit for something I can mostly do with my phone.
objection: For one small apartment it is too much money every month, and if the AI tells a German guest the wrong check-out time or wrong parking, the bad review hits me, not you.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around €15 a month only in summer, plus seeing it answer my real guests correctly for a few weeks before I pay anything.
